finalReading.passage: When Leo planted his first tree, it was no taller than his knee. He almost forgot about it, but his grandfather quietly watered it every single week. Ten years later, Leo returned to find a tall tree full of singing birds, and at last he understood why slow, patient care matters so much.

questions.q: Who took care of the young tree?
questions.explanation: 原文 'his grandfather quietly watered it every single week' 的转述;其余人物原文未提。

questions.q: What did Leo finally come to understand?
options: That trees grow best with no help.
That patient care is truly worth it.
That planting trees is a waste of time.
questions.explanation: 末句 'he understood why slow, patient care matters so much' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
